title: Brain structure abnormalities in neurodevelopmental synaptopathies.
abstract: MRI volumetry across SYNGAP1, GRIN-family and STXBP1 disorders found shared basal ganglia/thalamus/ventricle enlargement and white matter/cerebellar/limbic reduction; ventricular enlargement tracked ID, language and motor severity; amygdala deficits prominent in SYNGAP1 and GRINpathies.
